summary.en: The end card as a title block: a kicker, the product name dimensioned at 200 px, tags as framed chips, the URL in a framed field held at least 3 s, a key plan of the sheets, a foot line; RELEASED lettered in a framed field on the last downbeat.
summary.zh: 把落版画成标题栏：一行引语、200 px 并标注尺寸的产品名、带框的标签芯片、带框的网址（至少停 3 秒）、全部图纸的索引图、页脚；最后一个强拍在框里写上“已发布”。

fits: The last sheet of a blueprint film.
notFor: Logos that must be artwork; more than five tags; a film that ends unreleased (change the status word).

intent.en: End on the issued drawing: the name, what it does in four words, where to get it, and the status stamped as released.
intent.zh: 以发出的图纸收尾：名称、四个词说明它做什么、去哪获取，以及“已发布”的状态。

content.en: Label, kicker (≤ 40), name (≤ 14), 2–5 tags (≤ 14), URL (≤ 44), a foot line, the status word.
content.zh: 标签、引语（≤ 16 字）、名称（≤ 7 字）、2–5 个标签（≤ 5 字）、网址（≤ 44 字符）、页脚、状态词。

fits.zh: blueprint 片子的最后一张图。

notFor.zh: 必须画成图形的标志；超过五个标签；以“未发布”结束的片子（改状态词）。

pairs.note: entered from it under the parallel rule (occluder-pass)

en: RELEASED lands on the last downbeat (4 beats before the end): a host that cuts the scene short loses the closing move.
zh: “已发布”落在最后一个强拍（结束前 4 拍）；宿主截短这一场，收尾动作就没了。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
